import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('the step invokes the real CLI', function () {
  this.execution = spawnSync(process.execPath, [process.env.BDD_CORPUS_CLI!, '--help'], {
    encoding: 'utf8',
    env: process.env,
  });
});
Then('the result is sanitized runner-envelope evidence', function () {
  assert.equal(this.execution.status, 0);
});
